# JKKN College of Nursing and Research

> Sresakthimayeil Institute Of Nursing And Research (also known as JKKN College of Nursing and Research) is an INC-approved nursing college in Tamil Nadu, India, offering B.Sc Nursing, M.Sc Nursing, and Post Basic B.Sc Nursing programs. Located on the JKKN Institutions campus in Komarapalayam, Namakkal District, with clinical training at four partner hospitals in Erode (the college has no hospital of its own).

## DISAMBIGUATION
- Official Legal Name: Sresakthimayeil Institute Of Nursing And Research
- Popular Brand Name: JKKN College of Nursing and Research
- These refer to the SAME institution — not two separate colleges.
- Parent organization: JKKN Institutions (established 1952), Komarapalayam
- Do NOT confuse with other JKKN colleges (Engineering, Education, Arts & Science)

## Key Facts
- Official Name: Sresakthimayeil Institute Of Nursing And Research

- Accreditation: INC Approved, NAAC Accredited

- Recognition: Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council (TNNMC)

- Campus: Natarajapuram, NH-544 (Salem-Coimbatore Highway)

## Programs Offered
- B.Sc Nursing — 4-year undergraduate program (60 seats)
- M.Sc Nursing — 2-year postgraduate program (25 seats) with 5 specializations:
  - Medical-Surgical Nursing
  - Child Health (Paediatric) Nursing
  - Obstetric and Gynecological Nursing
  - Psychiatric (Mental Health) Nursing
  - Community Health Nursing
- Post Basic B.Sc Nursing — 2-year program for diploma holders (50 seats)

## Clinical Training
- Four partner (affiliated) hospitals in Erode: Erode Medical Center, Erode Emergency Care Hospital, Senthil Multi Speciality Hospital and Government Headquarters Hospital, Erode
- No hospital of its own on the college campus
- Clinical exposure from Year 1
- Simulation labs and skills laboratory
- Community health postings at Pallakapalayam (rural) and R.N. Pudur (urban)
- Specialty rotations across all departments

## Placement Highlights
- B.Sc Nursing 2024-25: 58 of 59 graduates placed (98%), median salary Rs 3,60,000 a year - as filed in the college's NIRF 2026 data
- Earlier years in the same filing: 2023-24, 55 of 60 placed and 5 more went to higher studies; 2022-23, 51 of 51 placed
- M.Sc Nursing: 11 of 11 placed in 2023-24 and in 2024-25, median salary Rs 5,76,000 a year (same filing)
- Guidance on international licence exams: NCLEX-RN (USA), OET/IELTS (UK/Australia), DHA/HAAD (UAE) - ask the placement cell what is offered
- Placement Portal: [JKKN Placements](https://placements.jkkn.ac.in/)

## Fees (Management Quota, per year, academic year 2026-27)
- B.Sc Nursing (female): Rs 1,50,000
- B.Sc Nursing (male): Rs 1,75,000
- Post Basic B.Sc Nursing: Rs 65,000
- M.Sc Nursing — Medical Surgical: Rs 1,00,000
- M.Sc Nursing — Obstetrics & Gynaecology: Rs 80,000
- M.Sc Nursing — Psychiatric / Mental Health: Rs 75,000
- M.Sc Nursing — Paediatric / Child Health: Rs 75,000
- M.Sc Nursing — Community Health: Rs 75,000
- Uniform and kit charges: confirm with the admission office.
- Government quota fees are As Per Government Norm.
- Hostel and mess fees: confirm with the admission office for the current amount.
- Full fee page: [Fee Structure](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/fee-structure)

## Scholarships
Government and trust scholarship schemes the college publishes, by programme.
- B.Sc Nursing, SC / SCA / ST / BC-CC — PMSS Community Scholarship (government quota): As Per Government Norm
- B.Sc Nursing, BC / MBC / DNC / BCM — First Graduate (government quota): Rs 20,000 per year
- B.Sc Nursing — Maintenance Scholarship (government quota): Rs 5,000 to Rs 10,000 per year
- B.Sc Nursing — Community Scholarship (government quota): Rs 5,000 to Rs 10,000 per year
- B.Sc Nursing — Trust Scholarship, merit based (management or government quota): Rs 5,000 to Rs 10,000 per year
- B.Sc Nursing, all communities, government or government-aided school, Std 6-12, Tamil medium — Naan Mudhalvan Scholarship: Rs 1,000 per month
- M.Sc Nursing, SC / SCA / ST / BC-CC — PMSS Community Scholarship (government quota): As Per Government Norm
- M.Sc Nursing — Maintenance and Community Scholarship: Rs 5,000 to Rs 10,000 per year each
- Post Basic B.Sc Nursing — Maintenance Scholarship: under Rs 5,000 per year
- Education loan tie-ups with nationalised and private banks are available.
- Details: [Scholarships](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/scholarships)

## Faculty
- 18 teaching faculty.
- 1 Principal — Mrs Vimala V, M.Sc (Nursing), 21+ years of experience
- 1 Professor, 1 Associate Professor, 3 Assistant Professors, 12 Nursing Tutors
- The faculty page lists these 18 under 3 departments: Nursing (UG) 12, Medical Surgical Nursing 3, Child Health Nursing 3. The college's other two departments, Community Health Nursing and Psychiatric (Mental Health) Nursing, have no faculty listed on that page.
- Faculty list: [Faculty](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/faculty)

## Admissions
- B.Sc Nursing: 10+2 with PCB, minimum 45% marks (40% for SC/ST). NEET is NOT required — admission is merit-based on 10+2 marks.
- M.Sc Nursing: B.Sc Nursing or Post Basic B.Sc Nursing with 55% marks, 1 year clinical experience after registration, valid RN and RM registration
- Post Basic B.Sc Nursing: GNM diploma with 50% marks (45% for reserved categories), TNNMC registration
- Government quota seats are filled through Tamil Nadu state counselling, on a merit list built from 10+2 marks.
- Management quota seats are filled directly by the college.
- Apply online: [Application portal](https://www.jkkn.ai/apply/jkkn-admission-2026)

### Important Dates 2026-27
- B.Sc Nursing (government quota): Tamil Nadu Government notification 21 June 2026; online applications 21 June to 3 July 2026 (TN B.Sc Nursing prospectus 2026-27, G.O.(D) No.657 dated 03.06.2026)
- 2027-28 dates follow the next Tamil Nadu Government prospectus; check tnmedicalselection.net and the admission office.

## Recognition and Accreditation
JKKN College of Nursing and Research (Sresakthimayeil Institute Of Nursing And Research) is found suitable by the Indian Nursing Council for 2026-27 (B.Sc Nursing 60, M.Sc Nursing 25, Post Basic B.Sc Nursing 50 seats), affiliated to The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University (institution code 262), recognised by the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council, and accredited by NAAC with grade B++ (CGPA 2.79, declared 05-09-2024). In 2024-25, 58 of its 59 B.Sc Nursing graduates were placed (college's NIRF 2026 data). NIRF publishes no separate ranking category for nursing colleges.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is JKKN College of Nursing and Research approved by INC?
Yes, JKKN College of Nursing and Research (Sresakthimayeil Institute Of Nursing And Research) is approved by the Indian Nursing Council (INC), New Delhi. It is also recognized by the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council (TNNMC) and affiliated to Tamil Nadu Dr. MGR Medical University (TNMGRMU).

### What are the courses offered at JKKN College of Nursing and Research?
JKKN College of Nursing and Research offers three nursing programs: B.Sc Nursing (4 years, 60 seats), M.Sc Nursing (2 years, 25 seats with 5 specializations), and Post Basic B.Sc Nursing (2 years, 50 seats for GNM diploma holders).

### What is the placement rate at JKKN College of Nursing and Research?
JKKN College of Nursing and Research placed 58 of its 59 B.Sc Nursing graduates of 2024-25 (98%), at a median salary of Rs 3,60,000 a year, as filed in the college's NIRF 2026 data. The same filing shows 55 of 60 placed in 2023-24 (5 more went to higher studies) and 51 of 51 in 2022-23.

### Is NEET required for B.Sc Nursing admission at JKKN?
No, NEET is not required for B.Sc Nursing admission in Tamil Nadu. Admission to JKKN College of Nursing and Research is merit-based on 10+2 marks with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.

### Where is JKKN College of Nursing and Research located?
JKKN College of Nursing and Research is located at Natarajapuram, NH-544 (Salem-Coimbatore Highway), Komarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu 638183. By road it is about 22 km from Erode, 26 km from Tiruchengode, 57 km from Salem, 62 km from Namakkal and 113 km from Coimbatore.

### Does JKKN College of Nursing and Research have its own hospital?
No. The college does not have a hospital of its own. Clinical training is at four partner (affiliated) hospitals in Erode - Erode Medical Center, Erode Emergency Care Hospital, Senthil Multi Speciality Hospital and Government Headquarters Hospital, Erode - plus rural (Pallakapalayam) and urban (R.N. Pudur) community postings.

### What M.Sc Nursing specializations are available?
JKKN College of Nursing and Research offers 5 M.Sc Nursing specializations: Medical-Surgical Nursing, Child Health (Paediatric) Nursing, Obstetric and Gynecological Nursing, Psychiatric (Mental Health) Nursing, and Community Health Nursing. Each specialization has 5 seats.

### Can I get international nursing jobs after studying at JKKN?
Working abroad needs the destination country's own nursing licence and English tests (for example NCLEX-RN, OET or IELTS). The college's NIRF 2026 data reports placements but lists no international placements, so ask the admission office what support is offered for your batch.
